## Fed Holds Rates; S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 Futures Rally with Meta, Microsoft, Apple in Focus Post-Earnings

A rate hold layered on top of MSFT earnings beats and META/AAPL in the queue is a double tailwind for tech multiples in the near term; the confluence of macro accommodation and strong AI-monetization prints is a favorable setup for the portfolio's core tech holdings.

- The Federal Reserve held interest rates, per headline framing.
- S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures moved higher following the decision.
- META, MSFT, and AAPL are cited as focal points, coinciding with their earnings cycle.
- A rate hold supports the multiple-expansion argument for growth/tech at a moment when several mega-caps are reporting beats.
